verses.original: יְחִזְקִיָּ֣הוּ מָלַ֗ךְ בֶּן־ עֶשְׂרִ֤ים וְחָמֵשׁ֙ שָׁנָ֔ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֤ים וָתֵ֙שַׁע֙ שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְשֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔וֹ אֲבִיָּ֖ה בַּת־ זְכַרְיָֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: yə·ḥiz·qî·yā·hū mā·laḵ ben- ‘eś·rîm wə·ḥā·mêš šā·nāh wə·‘eś·rîm wā·ṯê·ša‘ šā·nāh mā·laḵ bî·rū·šā·lim wə·šêm ’im·mōw ’ă·ḇî·yāh baṯ- zə·ḵar·yā·hū
verses.literal: Hezekiah was twenty-five . . . years old . . . when he became king and he reigned in Jerusalem twenty-nine . . . years His mother’s name was Abijah the daughter of Zechariah
verses.literalPt: TINHA Ezequias vinte e cinco anos de idade, quando começou a reinar, e reinou vinte e nove anos em Jerusalém; e era o nome de sua mãe Abia, filha de Zacarias.

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ הַיָּשָׁ֖ר בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ עָשָׂ֖ה דָּוִ֥יד אָבִֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś hay·yā·šār bə·‘ê·nê Yah·weh kə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- ‘ā·śāh dā·wîḏ ’ā·ḇîw
verses.literal: And he did what was right in the eyes of the LORD just as his father David had done
verses.literalPt: E fez o que era reto aos olhos do SENHOR, conforme a tudo quanto fizera Davi, seu pai.

verses.original: ה֣וּא בַשָּׁנָה֩ הָרִאשׁוֹנָ֨ה לְמָלְכ֜וֹ בַּחֹ֣דֶשׁ הָרִאשׁ֗וֹן פָּתַ֛ח אֶת־ דַּלְת֥וֹת בֵּית־ יְהוָ֖ה וַֽיְחַזְּקֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: hū ḇaš·šā·nāh hā·ri·šō·w·nāh lə·mā·lə·ḵōw ba·ḥō·ḏeš hā·ri·šō·wn pā·ṯaḥ ’eṯ- dal·ṯō·wṯ bêṯ- Yah·weh way·ḥaz·zə·qêm
verses.literal: In the first month of the first year of his reign Hezekiah opened and repaired the doors of the house of the LORD
verses.literalPt: Ele, no primeiro ano do seu reinado, no primeiro mês, abriu as portas da casa do SENHOR, e as reparou.

verses.original: וַיָּבֵ֥א אֶת־ הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים וְאֶת־ הַלְוִיִּ֑ם וַיַּֽאַסְפֵ֖ם לִרְח֥וֹב הַמִּזְרָֽח׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇê ’eṯ- hak·kō·hă·nîm wə·’eṯ- hal·wî·yim way·ya·’as·p̄êm lir·ḥō·wḇ ham·miz·rāḥ
verses.literal: Then he brought in the priests and Levites and gathered them in the square on the east side
verses.literalPt: E trouxe os sacerdotes, e os levitas, e ajuntou-os na praça oriental,

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר לָהֶ֖ם שְׁמָע֣וּנִי הַלְוִיִּ֑ם עַתָּ֣ה הִֽתְקַדְּשׁ֗וּ וְקַדְּשׁוּ֙ אֶת־ בֵּ֤ית יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י אֲבֹתֵיכֶ֔ם וְהוֹצִ֥יאוּ אֶת־ הַנִּדָּ֖ה מִן־ הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lā·hem šə·mā·‘ū·nî hal·wî·yim ‘at·tāh hiṯ·qad·də·šū wə·qad·də·šū ’eṯ- bêṯ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê ’ă·ḇō·ṯê·ḵem wə·hō·w·ṣî·’ū ’eṯ- han·nid·dāh min- haq·qō·ḏeš
verses.literal: Listen to me O Levites he said Consecrate yourselves now and consecrate the house of the LORD the God of your fathers Remove from the Holy Place every impurity
verses.literalPt: E lhes disse: Ouvi-me, ó levitas, santificai-vos agora, e santificai a casa do SENHOR Deus de vossos pais, e tirai do santuário a imundícia.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ מָעֲל֣וּ אֲבֹתֵ֗ינוּ וְעָשׂ֥וּ הָרַ֛ע בְּעֵינֵ֥י יְהוָֽה־ אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ וַיַּֽעַזְבֻ֑הוּ וַיַּסֵּ֧בּוּ פְנֵיהֶ֛ם מִמִּשְׁכַּ֥ן יְהוָ֖ה וַיִּתְּנוּ־ עֹֽרֶף׃
verses.transliteration: kî- mā·‘ă·lū ’ă·ḇō·ṯê·nū wə·‘ā·śū hā·ra‘ bə·‘ê·nê Yah·weh- ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū way·ya·‘az·ḇu·hū way·yas·sêb·bū p̄ə·nê·hem mim·miš·kan Yah·weh way·yit·tə·nū- ‘ō·rep̄
verses.literal: For our fathers were unfaithful and did evil in the sight of the LORD our God They abandoned Him turned their faces away from the dwelling place of the LORD and turned their backs on Him
verses.literalPt: Porque nossos pais transgrediram, e fizeram o que era mau aos olhos do SENHOR nosso Deus, e o deixaram, e desviaram os seus rostos do tabernáculo do SENHOR, e lhe deram as costas.

verses.original: גַּ֣ם סָֽגְר֞וּ דַּלְת֣וֹת הָאוּלָ֗ם וַיְכַבּוּ֙ אֶת־ הַנֵּר֔וֹת וּקְטֹ֖רֶת לֹ֣א הִקְטִ֑ירוּ וְעֹלָה֙ לֹא־ הֶעֱל֣וּ בַקֹּ֔דֶשׁ לֵאלֹהֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: gam sā·ḡə·rū dal·ṯō·wṯ hā·’ū·lām way·ḵab·bū ’eṯ- han·nê·rō·wṯ ū·qə·ṭō·reṯ lō hiq·ṭî·rū wə·‘ō·lāh lō- he·‘ĕ·lū ḇaq·qō·ḏeš lê·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: They also shut the doors of the portico and extinguished the lamps They did not burn incense or present burnt offerings in the Holy Place of the God of Israel
verses.literalPt: Também fecharam as portas do alpendre, e apagaram as lâmpadas, e não queimaram incenso nem ofereceram holocaustos no santuário ao Deus de Israel.

verses.original: וַיְהִי֙ קֶ֣צֶף יְהוָ֔ה עַל־ יְהוּדָ֖ה וִירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וַיִּתְּנֵ֤ם לִזְוָעָה לְשַׁמָּ֣ה וְלִשְׁרֵקָ֔ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר אַתֶּ֥ם רֹאִ֖ים בְּעֵינֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî qe·ṣep̄ Yah·weh ‘al- yə·hū·ḏāh wî·rū·šā·lim way·yit·tə·nêm liz·wå̄·ʿå̄h lə·šam·māh wə·liš·rê·qāh ka·’ă·šer ’at·tem rō·’îm bə·‘ê·nê·ḵem
verses.literal: Therefore, the wrath of the LORD has fallen upon Judah and Jerusalem and He has made them an object of terror horror and scorn as you can see with your own eyes
verses.literalPt: Por isso veio grande ira do SENHOR sobre Judá e Jerusalém, e os entregou à perturbação, à assolação, e ao escárnio, como vós o estais vendo com os vossos olhos.

verses.original: וְהִנֵּ֛ה נָפְל֥וּ אֲבוֹתֵ֖ינוּ בֶּחָ֑רֶב וּבָנֵ֨ינוּ וּבְנוֹתֵ֧ינוּ וְנָשֵׁ֛ינוּ בַּשְּׁבִ֖י עַל־ זֹֽאת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hin·nêh nā·p̄ə·lū ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯê·nū be·ḥā·reḇ ū·ḇā·nê·nū ū·ḇə·nō·w·ṯê·nū wə·nā·šê·nū baš·šə·ḇî ‘al- zōṯ
verses.literal: For behold this is why our fathers have fallen by the sword and our sons and daughters and wives are in captivity
verses.literalPt: Porque eis que nossos pais caíram à espada, e nossos filhos, e nossas filhas, e nossas mulheres; por isso estiveram em cativeiro.

verses.original: עַתָּה֙ עִם־ לְבָבִ֔י לִכְר֣וֹת בְּרִ֔ית לַיהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְיָשֹׁ֥ב מִמֶּ֖נּוּ חֲר֥וֹן אַפּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘at·tāh ‘im- lə·ḇā·ḇî liḵ·rō·wṯ bə·rîṯ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl wə·yā·šōḇ mim·men·nū ḥă·rō·wn ’ap·pōw
verses.literal: Now it is in my heart to make a covenant with the LORD the God of Israel so that His fierce anger . . . will turn away from us
verses.literalPt: Agora me tem vindo ao coração, que façamos uma aliança com o SENHOR Deus de Israel, para que se desvie de nós o ardor da sua ira.

verses.original: בָּנַ֕י עַתָּ֖ה אַל־ תִּשָּׁל֑וּ כִּֽי־ בָכֶ֞ם בָּחַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה לַעֲמֹ֤ד לְפָנָיו֙ לְשָׁ֣רְת֔וֹ וְלִהְי֥וֹת ל֖וֹ מְשָׁרְתִ֥ים וּמַקְטִרִֽים׃ס
verses.transliteration: bā·nay ‘at·tāh ’al- tiš·šā·lū kî- ḇā·ḵem bā·ḥar Yah·weh la·‘ă·mōḏ lə·p̄ā·nāw lə·šā·rə·ṯōw wə·lih·yō·wṯ lōw mə·šā·rə·ṯîm ū·maq·ṭi·rîm
verses.literal: Now my sons do not be negligent for the LORD has chosen you to stand before Him to serve Him to minister before Him and to burn incense
verses.literalPt: Agora, filhos meus, não sejais negligentes; pois o SENHOR vos tem escolhido para estardes diante dele para o servirdes, e para serdes seus ministros e queimadores de incenso.

verses.original: וַיָּקֻ֣מוּ הַ֠לְוִיִּם מַ֣חַת בֶּן־ עֲמָשַׂ֞י וְיוֹאֵ֣ל בֶּן־ עֲזַרְיָהוּ֮ מִן־ בְּנֵ֣י הַקְּהָתִי֒ וּמִן־ בְּנֵ֣י מְרָרִ֔י קִ֚ישׁ בֶּן־ עַבְדִּ֔י וַעֲזַרְיָ֖הוּ בֶּן־ יְהַלֶּלְאֵ֑ל וּמִן־ הַגֵּ֣רְשֻׁנִּ֔י יוֹאָח֙ בֶּן־ זִמָּ֔ה וְעֵ֖דֶן בֶּן־ יוֹאָֽח׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·qu·mū hal·wî·yim ma·ḥaṯ ben- ‘ă·mā·śay wə·yō·w·’êl ben- ‘ă·zar·yā·hū min- bə·nê haq·qə·hā·ṯî ū·min- bə·nê mə·rā·rî qîš ben- ‘aḇ·dî wa·‘ă·zar·yā·hū ben- yə·hal·lel·’êl ū·min- hag·gê·rə·šun·nî yō·w·’āḥ ben- zim·māh wə·‘ê·ḏen ben- yō·w·’āḥ
verses.literal: Then the Levites set to work Mahath son of Amasai and Joel son of Azariah from the Kohathites . . . Kish son of Abdi and Azariah son of Jehallelel from the Merarites Joah son of Zimmah and Eden son of Joah from the Gershonites
verses.literalPt: Então se levantaram os levitas, Maate, filho de Amasai, e Joel, filho de Azarias, dos filhos dos coatitas; e dos filhos de Merari, Quis, filho de Abdi, e Azarias, filho de Jealelel; e dos gersonitas, Joá, filho de Zima, e Éden, filho de Joá;

verses.original: וּמִן־ בְּנֵי֙ אֱלִ֣יצָפָ֔ן שִׁמְרִ֖י וִיעוּאֵל וּמִן־ בְּנֵ֣י אָסָ֔ף זְכַרְיָ֖הוּ וּמַתַּנְיָֽהוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·min- bə·nê ’ĕ·lî·ṣā·p̄ān šim·rî wī·ʿū·ʾēl ū·min- bə·nê ’ā·sāp̄ zə·ḵar·yā·hū ū·mat·tan·yā·hū
verses.literal: Shimri and Jeuel from the Elizaphanites . . . Zechariah and Mattaniah from the Asaphites . . .
verses.literalPt: E dentre os filhos de Elisafã, Sinri e Jeuel; dentre os filhos de Asafe, Zacarias e Matanias;

verses.original: וּמִן־ בְּנֵ֥י הֵימָ֖ן יְחוּאֵל וְשִׁמְעִ֑יס וּמִן־ בְּנֵ֣י יְדוּת֔וּן שְׁמַֽעְיָ֖ה וְעֻזִּיאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ū·min- bə·nê hê·mān yə·ḥū·ʾēl wə·šim·ʿīs ū·min- bə·nê yə·ḏū·ṯūn šə·ma‘·yāh wə·‘uz·zî·’êl
verses.literal: Jehiel and Shimei from the Hemanites . . . and Shemaiah and Uzziel from the Jeduthunites . . .
verses.literalPt: E dentre os filhos de Hemam, Jeuel e Simei; e dentre os filhos de Jedutum, Semaías e Uziel.

verses.original: וַיַּֽאַסְפ֤וּ אֶת־ אֲחֵיהֶם֙ וַיִּֽתְקַדְּשׁ֔וּ וַיָּבֹ֥אוּ כְמִצְוַת־ הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ בְּדִבְרֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה לְטַהֵ֖ר בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·’as·p̄ū ’eṯ- ’ă·ḥê·hem way·yiṯ·qad·də·šū way·yā·ḇō·’ū ḵə·miṣ·waṯ- ham·me·leḵ bə·ḏiḇ·rê Yah·weh lə·ṭa·hêr bêṯ Yah·weh
verses.literal: When they had assembled their brothers and consecrated themselves they went in to cleanse the house of the LORD according to the command of the king by the words of the LORD
verses.literalPt: E ajuntaram a seus irmãos, e santificaram-se e vieram conforme ao mandado do rei, pelas palavras do SENHOR, para purificarem a casa do SENHOR.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֣אוּ הַ֠כֹּהֲנִים לִפְנִ֣ימָה בֵית־ יְהוָה֮ לְטַהֵר֒ וַיּוֹצִ֗יאוּ אֵ֤ת כָּל־ הַטֻּמְאָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר מָֽצְאוּ֙ בְּהֵיכַ֣ל יְהוָ֔ה לַחֲצַ֖ר בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה וַֽיְקַבְּלוּ֙ הַלְוִיִּ֔ם לְהוֹצִ֥יא לְנַֽחַל־ קִדְר֖וֹן חֽוּצָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō·’ū hak·kō·hă·nîm lip̄·nî·māh ḇêṯ- Yah·weh lə·ṭa·hêr way·yō·w·ṣî·’ū ’êṯ kāl- haṭ·ṭum·’āh ’ă·šer mā·ṣə·’ū bə·hê·ḵal Yah·weh la·ḥă·ṣar bêṯ Yah·weh way·qab·bə·lū hal·wî·yim lə·hō·w·ṣî lə·na·ḥal- qiḏ·rō·wn ḥū·ṣāh
verses.literal: So the priests went inside the house of the LORD to cleanse it and they brought out to the courtyard - all the unclean things that they found in the temple of the LORD Then the Levites took these things and carried them out to the Kidron Valley
verses.literalPt: E os sacerdotes entraram na casa do SENHOR, para a purificar, e tiraram para fora, ao pátio da casa do SENHOR, toda a imundícia que acharam no templo do SENHOR; e os levitas a tomaram, para a levarem para fora, ao ribeiro de Cedrom.

verses.original: וַ֠יָּחֵלּוּ בְּאֶחָ֞ד לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הָרִאשׁוֹן֮ לְקַדֵּשׁ֒ וּבְי֧וֹם שְׁמוֹנָ֣ה לַחֹ֗דֶשׁ בָּ֚אוּ לְאוּלָ֣ם יְהוָ֔ה וַיְקַדְּשׁ֥וּ אֶת־ בֵּית־ יְהוָ֖ה לְיָמִ֣ים שְׁמוֹנָ֑ה וּבְי֨וֹם שִׁשָּׁ֥ה עָשָׂ֛ר לַחֹ֥דֶשׁ הָרִאשׁ֖וֹן כִּלּֽוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḥêl·lū bə·’e·ḥāḏ la·ḥō·ḏeš hā·ri·šō·wn lə·qad·dêš ū·ḇə·yō·wm šə·mō·w·nāh la·ḥō·ḏeš bā·’ū lə·’ū·lām Yah·weh way·qad·də·šū ’eṯ- bêṯ- Yah·weh lə·yā·mîm šə·mō·w·nāh ū·ḇə·yō·wm šiš·šāh ‘ā·śār la·ḥō·ḏeš hā·ri·šō·wn kil·lū
verses.literal: They began the consecration on the first day of the first month and on the eighth day of the month they reached the portico of the LORD For eight more days they consecrated the house of the LORD itself finishing on the sixteenth . . . day of the first month
verses.literalPt: Começaram, pois, a santificar no primeiro dia, do primeiro mês; e ao oitavo dia do mês vieram ao alpendre do SENHOR, e santificaram a casa do SENHOR em oito dias; e no dia décimo sexto do primeiro mês acabaram.

verses.original: וַיָּב֤וֹאוּ פְנִ֙ימָה֙ אֶל־ חִזְקִיָּ֣הוּ הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ טִהַ֖רְנוּ אֶת־ כָּל־ בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה אֶת־ מִזְבַּ֤ח הָעוֹלָה֙ וְאֶת־ כָּל־ כֵּלָ֔יו וְאֶת־ שֻׁלְחַ֥ן הַֽמַּעֲרֶ֖כֶת וְאֶת־ כָּל־ כֵּלָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō·w·’ū p̄ə·nî·māh ’el- ḥiz·qî·yā·hū ham·me·leḵ way·yō·mə·rū ṭi·har·nū ’eṯ- kāl- bêṯ Yah·weh ’eṯ- miz·baḥ hā·‘ō·w·lāh wə·’eṯ- kāl- kê·lāw wə·’eṯ- šul·ḥan ham·ma·‘ă·re·ḵeṯ wə·’eṯ- kāl- kê·lāw
verses.literal: Then they went in to King Hezekiah and reported We have cleansed the entire house of the LORD the altar of burnt offering with all its utensils and the table of the showbread with all its utensils
verses.literalPt: Então foram ter com o rei Ezequias, e disseram: Já purificamos toda a casa do SENHOR, como também o altar do holocausto com todos os seus utensílios e a mesa da proposição com todos os seus utensílios.

verses.original: וְאֵ֣ת כָּל־ הַכֵּלִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִזְנִיחַ֩ הַמֶּ֨לֶךְ אָחָ֧ז בְּמַלְכוּת֛וֹ בְּמַעֲל֖וֹ הֵכַ֣נּוּ וְהִקְדָּ֑שְׁנוּ וְהִנָּ֕ם לִפְנֵ֖י מִזְבַּ֥ח יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·’êṯ kāl- hak·kê·lîm ’ă·šer hiz·nî·aḥ ham·me·leḵ ’ā·ḥāz bə·mal·ḵū·ṯōw bə·ma·‘ă·lōw hê·ḵan·nū wə·hiq·dā·šə·nū wə·hin·nām lip̄·nê miz·baḥ Yah·weh
verses.literal: Moreover we have prepared and consecrated . . . all the articles that King Ahaz in his unfaithfulness cast aside during his reign They are now in front of the altar of the LORD
verses.literalPt: Também todos os objetos que o rei Acaz no seu reinado lançou fora, na sua transgressão, já preparamos e santificamos; e eis que estão diante do altar do SENHOR.

verses.original: וַיַּשְׁכֵּם֙ יְחִזְקִיָּ֣הוּ הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וַיֶּאֱסֹ֕ף אֵ֖ת שָׂרֵ֣י הָעִ֑יר וַיַּ֖עַל בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yaš·kêm yə·ḥiz·qî·yā·hū ham·me·leḵ way·ye·’ĕ·sōp̄ ’êṯ śā·rê hā·‘îr way·ya·‘al bêṯ Yah·weh
verses.literal: Early the next morning King Hezekiah gathered the city officials and went up to the house of the LORD
verses.literalPt: Então o rei Ezequias se levantou de madrugada, e reuniu os líderes da cidade, e subiu à casa do SENHOR.

verses.original: וַיָּבִ֣יאוּ פָרִים־ שִׁבְעָה֩ וְאֵילִ֨ים שִׁבְעָ֜ה וּכְבָשִׂ֣ים שִׁבְעָ֗ה וּצְפִירֵ֨י עִזִּ֤ים שִׁבְעָה֙ לְחַטָּ֔את עַל־ הַמַּמְלָכָ֥ה וְעַל־ הַמִּקְדָּ֖שׁ וְעַל־ יְהוּדָ֑ה וַיֹּ֗אמֶר לִבְנֵ֤י אַהֲרֹן֙ הַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים לְהַעֲל֖וֹת עַל־ מִזְבַּ֥ח יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇî·’ū p̄ā·rîm- šiḇ·‘āh wə·’ê·lîm šiḇ·‘āh ū·ḵə·ḇā·śîm šiḇ·‘āh ū·ṣə·p̄î·rê ‘iz·zîm šiḇ·‘āh lə·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ ‘al- ham·mam·lā·ḵāh wə·‘al- ham·miq·dāš wə·‘al- yə·hū·ḏāh way·yō·mer liḇ·nê ’a·hă·rōn hak·kō·hă·nîm lə·ha·‘ă·lō·wṯ ‘al- miz·baḥ Yah·weh
verses.literal: They brought seven bulls seven rams seven lambs and seven male goats . . . as a sin offering for the kingdom for the sanctuary and for Judah And the king commanded the priests the descendants of Aaron to offer them on the altar of the LORD
verses.literalPt: E trouxeram sete novilhos e sete carneiros, e sete cordeiros e sete bodes, para sacrifício pelo pecado, pelo reino, e pelo santuário, e por Judá, e disse aos filhos de Arão, os sacerdotes, que os oferecessem sobre o altar do SENHOR.

verses.original: וַֽיִּשְׁחֲטוּ֙ הַבָּקָ֔ר וַיְקַבְּל֤וּ הַכֹּֽהֲנִים֙ אֶת־ הַדָּ֔ם וַֽיִּזְרְק֖וּ הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חָה וַיִּשְׁחֲט֣וּ הָאֵלִ֗ים וַיִּזְרְק֤וּ הַדָּם֙ הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חָה וַֽיִּשְׁחֲטוּ֙ הַכְּבָשִׂ֔ים וַיִּזְרְק֥וּ הַדָּ֖ם הַמִּזְבֵּֽחָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·ḥă·ṭū hab·bā·qār way·qab·bə·lū hak·kō·hă·nîm ’eṯ- had·dām way·yiz·rə·qū ham·miz·bê·ḥāh way·yiš·ḥă·ṭū hā·’ê·lîm way·yiz·rə·qū had·dām ham·miz·bê·ḥāh way·yiš·ḥă·ṭū hak·kə·ḇā·śîm way·yiz·rə·qū had·dām ham·miz·bê·ḥāh
verses.literal: So they slaughtered the bulls and the priests took the blood and splattered it on the altar They slaughtered the rams and splattered the blood on the altar And they slaughtered the lambs and splattered the blood on the altar
verses.literalPt: E eles mataram os bois, e os sacerdotes tomaram o sangue e o espargiram sobre o altar; também mataram os carneiros, e espargiram o sangue sobre o altar; semelhantemente mataram os cordeiros, e espargiram o sangue sobre o altar.

verses.original: וַיַּגִּ֙ישׁוּ֙ אֶת־ שְׂעִירֵ֣י הַֽחַטָּ֔את לִפְנֵ֥י הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ וְהַקָּהָ֑ל וַיִּסְמְכ֥וּ יְדֵיהֶ֖ם עֲלֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yag·gî·šū ’eṯ- śə·‘î·rê ha·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ lip̄·nê ham·me·leḵ wə·haq·qā·hāl way·yis·mə·ḵū yə·ḏê·hem ‘ă·lê·hem
verses.literal: Then they brought the goats for the sin offering before the king and the assembly who laid their hands on them
verses.literalPt: Então trouxeram os bodes para sacrifício pelo pecado, perante o rei e a congregação, e lhes impuseram as suas mãos.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁחָטוּם֙ הַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים וַֽיְחַטְּא֤וּ אֶת־ דָּמָם֙ הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חָה לְכַפֵּ֖ר עַל־ כָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כִּ֤י לְכָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אָמַ֣ר הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ הָעוֹלָ֖ה וְהַחַטָּֽאת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·ḥā·ṭūm hak·kō·hă·nîm way·ḥaṭ·ṭə·’ū ’eṯ- dā·mām ham·miz·bê·ḥāh lə·ḵap·pêr ‘al- kāl- yiś·rā·’êl kî lə·ḵāl yiś·rā·’êl ’ā·mar ham·me·leḵ hā·‘ō·w·lāh wə·ha·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ
verses.literal: And the priests slaughtered the goats and put their blood on the altar for a sin offering to make atonement for all Israel because the king had ordered the burnt offering and the sin offering for all Israel
verses.literalPt: E os sacerdotes os mataram, e com o seu sangue fizeram expiação do pecado sobre o altar, para reconciliar a todo o Israel; porque o rei tinha ordenado que se fizesse aquele holocausto e sacrifício pelo pecado, por todo o Israel.

verses.original: וַיַּֽעֲמֵ֨ד אֶת־ הַלְוִיִּ֜ם בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֗ה בִּמְצִלְתַּ֙יִם֙ בִּנְבָלִ֣ים וּבְכִנֹּר֔וֹת בְּמִצְוַ֥ת דָּוִ֛יד וְגָ֥ד חֹזֵֽה־ הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ וְנָתָ֣ן הַנָּבִ֑יא כִּ֧י בְיַד־ יְהוָ֛ה הַמִּצְוָ֖ה בְּיַד־ נְבִיאָֽיו׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·mêḏ ’eṯ- hal·wî·yim bêṯ Yah·weh bim·ṣil·ta·yim bin·ḇā·lîm ū·ḇə·ḵin·nō·rō·wṯ bə·miṣ·waṯ dā·wîḏ wə·ḡāḏ ḥō·zêh- ham·me·leḵ wə·nā·ṯān han·nā·ḇî kî ḇə·yaḏ- Yah·weh ham·miṣ·wāh bə·yaḏ- nə·ḇî·’āw
verses.literal: Hezekiah stationed the Levites in the house of the LORD with cymbals harps and lyres according to the command of David of Gad the king’s seer and of Nathan the prophet For the command had come from the LORD through His prophets
verses.literalPt: E pôs os levitas na casa do SENHOR com címbalos, com saltérios, e com harpas, conforme ao mandado de Davi e de Gade, o vidente do rei, e do profeta Natã; porque este mandado veio do SENHOR, por mão de seus profetas.

verses.original: וַיַּֽעַמְד֤וּ הַלְוִיִּם֙ בִּכְלֵ֣י דָוִ֔יד וְהַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים בַּחֲצֹצְרֽוֹת׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘am·ḏū hal·wî·yim biḵ·lê ḏā·wîḏ wə·hak·kō·hă·nîm ba·ḥă·ṣō·ṣə·rō·wṯ
verses.literal: The Levites stood with the instruments of David and the priests with the trumpets
verses.literalPt: Estavam, pois, os levitas em pé com os instrumentos de Davi, e os sacerdotes com as trombetas.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ חִזְקִיָּ֔הוּ לְהַעֲל֥וֹת הָעֹלָ֖ה לְהַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וּבְעֵ֞ת הֵחֵ֣ל הָֽעוֹלָ֗ה הֵחֵ֤ל שִׁיר־ יְהוָה֙ וְהַחֲצֹ֣צְר֔וֹת וְעַ֨ל־ יְדֵ֔י כְּלֵ֖י דָּוִ֥יד מֶֽלֶךְ־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ḥiz·qî·yā·hū lə·ha·‘ă·lō·wṯ hā·‘ō·lāh lə·ham·miz·bê·aḥ ū·ḇə·‘êṯ hê·ḥêl hā·‘ō·w·lāh hê·ḥêl šîr- Yah·weh wə·ha·ḥă·ṣō·ṣə·rō·wṯ wə·‘al- yə·ḏê kə·lê dā·wîḏ me·leḵ- yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: And Hezekiah ordered that the burnt offering be sacrificed on the altar When the burnt offering began the song of the LORD and the trumpets began as well accompanied by . . . the instruments of David king of Israel
verses.literalPt: E Ezequias deu ordem que oferecessem o holocausto sobre o altar; e ao tempo em que começou o holocausto, começou também o canto do SENHOR, com as trombetas e com os instrumentos de Davi, rei de Israel.

verses.original: וְכָל־ הַקָּהָל֙ מִֽשְׁתַּחֲוִ֔ים וְהַשִּׁ֣יר מְשׁוֹרֵ֔ר וְהַחֲצֹצְר֖וֹת מַחֲצֹצְרִים הַכֹּ֕ל עַ֖ד לִכְל֥וֹת הָעֹלָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵāl haq·qā·hāl miš·ta·ḥă·wîm wə·haš·šîr mə·šō·w·rêr wə·ha·ḥă·ṣō·ṣə·rō·wṯ ma·ḥă·ṣō·ṣə·rīm hak·kōl ‘aḏ liḵ·lō·wṯ hā·‘ō·lāh
verses.literal: The whole assembly was worshiping the singers were singing and the trumpeters were playing All this continued until the burnt offering was completed
verses.literalPt: E toda a congregação se prostrou, quando entoavam o canto, e as trombetas eram tocadas; tudo isto até o holocausto se acabar.

verses.original: וּכְכַלּ֖וֹת לְהַעֲל֑וֹת כָּרְע֗וּ הַמֶּ֛לֶךְ וְכָֽל־ הַנִּמְצְאִ֥ים אִתּ֖וֹ וַיִּֽשְׁתַּחֲוֽוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḵə·ḵal·lō·wṯ lə·ha·‘ă·lō·wṯ kā·rə·‘ū ham·me·leḵ wə·ḵāl han·nim·ṣə·’îm ’it·tōw way·yiš·ta·ḥă·wū
verses.literal: When the offerings were completed the king and all those present with him bowed down and worshiped
verses.literalPt: E acabando de o oferecer, o rei e todos quantos com ele se achavam se prostraram e adoraram.

verses.original: וַ֠יֹּאמֶר יְחִזְקִיָּ֨הוּ הַמֶּ֤לֶךְ וְהַשָּׂרִים֙ לַלְוִיִּ֔ם לְהַלֵּל֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה בְּדִבְרֵ֥י דָוִ֖יד וְאָסָ֣ף הַחֹזֶ֑ה וַֽיְהַלְלוּ֙ עַד־ לְשִׂמְחָ֔ה וַֽיִּקְּד֖וּ וַיִּֽשְׁתַּחֲוֽוּ׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer yə·ḥiz·qî·yā·hū ham·me·leḵ wə·haś·śā·rîm lal·wî·yim lə·hal·lêl Yah·weh bə·ḏiḇ·rê ḏā·wîḏ wə·’ā·sāp̄ ha·ḥō·zeh way·hal·lū ‘aḏ- lə·śim·ḥāh way·yiq·qə·ḏū way·yiš·ta·ḥă·wū
verses.literal: Then King Hezekiah and his officials ordered the Levites to sing praises to the LORD in the words of David and of Asaph the seer So they sang praises . . . with gladness and bowed down and worshiped
verses.literalPt: Então o rei Ezequias e os príncipes disseram aos levitas que louvassem ao SENHOR com as palavras de Davi, e de Asafe, o vidente. E o louvaram com alegria e se inclinaram e adoraram.

verses.original: וַיַּ֨עַן יְחִזְקִיָּ֜הוּ וַיֹּ֗אמֶר עַתָּ֨ה מִלֵּאתֶ֤ם יֶדְכֶם֙ לַיהוָ֔ה גֹּ֧שׁוּ וְהָבִ֛יאוּ זְבָחִ֥ים וְתוֹד֖וֹת לְבֵ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה וַיָּבִ֤יאוּ הַקָּהָל֙ זְבָחִ֣ים וְתוֹד֔וֹת וְכָל־ נְדִ֥יב לֵ֖ב עֹלֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘an yə·ḥiz·qî·yā·hū way·yō·mer ‘at·tāh mil·lê·ṯem yeḏ·ḵem Yah·weh gō·šū wə·hā·ḇî·’ū zə·ḇā·ḥîm wə·ṯō·w·ḏō·wṯ lə·ḇêṯ Yah·weh way·yā·ḇî·’ū haq·qā·hāl zə·ḇā·ḥîm wə·ṯō·w·ḏō·wṯ wə·ḵāl nə·ḏîḇ lêḇ ‘ō·lō·wṯ
verses.literal: Then Hezekiah said Now that you have consecrated yourselves to the LORD come near and bring sacrifices and thank offerings to the house of the LORD So the assembly brought sacrifices and thank offerings and all whose hearts were willing brought burnt offerings
verses.literalPt: E respondeu Ezequias, dizendo: Agora vos consagrastes a vós mesmos ao SENHOR; chegai-vos e trazei sacrifícios e ofertas de louvor à casa do SENHOR. E a congregação trouxe sacrifícios e ofertas de louvor, e todos os dispostos de coração trouxeram holocaustos.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֞י מִסְפַּ֣ר הָעֹלָה֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֵבִ֣יאוּ הַקָּהָל֒ בָּקָ֣ר שִׁבְעִ֔ים אֵילִ֥ים מֵאָ֖ה כְּבָשִׂ֣ים מָאתָ֑יִם לְעֹלָ֥ה לַיהוָ֖ה כָּל־ אֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî mis·par hā·‘ō·lāh ’ă·šer hê·ḇî·’ū haq·qā·hāl bā·qār šiḇ·‘îm ’ê·lîm mê·’āh kə·ḇā·śîm mā·ṯā·yim lə·‘ō·lāh Yah·weh kāl- ’êl·leh
verses.literal: The number of burnt offerings the assembly brought was seventy bulls a hundred rams and two hundred lambs all these were for a burnt offering to the LORD
verses.literalPt: E o número dos holocaustos, que a congregação trouxe, foi de setenta bois, cem carneiros, duzentos cordeiros; tudo isto em holocausto para o SENHOR.

verses.original: וְֽהַקֳּדָשִׁ֑ים בָּקָר֙ שֵׁ֣שׁ מֵא֔וֹת וְצֹ֖אן שְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת אֲלָפִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·haq·qo·ḏā·šîm bā·qār šêš mê·’ō·wṯ wə·ṣōn šə·lō·šeṯ ’ă·lā·p̄îm
verses.literal: And the consecrated offerings were six hundred bulls and three thousand sheep
verses.literalPt: Houve, também, de coisas consagradas, seiscentos bois e três mil ovelhas.

verses.original: רַ֤ק הַכֹּֽהֲנִים֙ הָי֣וּ לִמְעָ֔ט וְלֹ֣א יָֽכְל֔וּ לְהַפְשִׁ֖יט אֶת־ כָּל־ הָעֹל֑וֹת וַֽיְּחַזְּק֞וּם אֲחֵיהֶ֣ם הַלְוִיִּ֗ם עַד־ כְּל֤וֹת הַמְּלָאכָה֙ וְעַ֣ד יִתְקַדְּשׁ֣וּ הַכֹּֽהֲנִ֔ים כִּ֤י הַלְוִיִּם֙ יִשְׁרֵ֣י לֵבָ֔ב לְהִתְקַדֵּ֖שׁ מֵֽהַכֹּהֲנִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: raq hak·kō·hă·nîm hā·yū lim·‘āṭ wə·lō yā·ḵə·lū lə·hap̄·šîṭ ’eṯ- kāl- hā·‘ō·lō·wṯ way·yə·ḥaz·zə·qūm ’ă·ḥê·hem hal·wî·yim ‘aḏ- kə·lō·wṯ ham·mə·lā·ḵāh wə·‘aḏ yiṯ·qad·də·šū hak·kō·hă·nîm kî hal·wî·yim yiš·rê lê·ḇāḇ lə·hiṯ·qad·dêš mê·hak·kō·hă·nîm
verses.literal: However since there were not enough priests - to skin all the burnt offerings their Levite brothers helped them until the work was finished and until the priests had consecrated themselves For the Levites had been more diligent . . . in consecrating themselves than the priests had been
verses.literalPt: Eram, porém, os sacerdotes mui poucos, e não podiam esfolar a todos os holocaustos; pelo que seus irmãos os levitas os ajudaram, até a obra se acabar, e até que os outros sacerdotes se santificaram; porque os levitas foram mais retos de coração, para se santificarem, do que os sacerdotes.

verses.original: וְגַם־ עֹלָ֨ה לָרֹ֜ב בְּחֶלְבֵ֧י הַשְּׁלָמִ֛ים וּבַנְּסָכִ֖ים לָעֹלָ֑ה וַתִּכּ֖וֹן עֲבוֹדַ֥ת בֵּית־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡam- ‘ō·lāh lā·rōḇ bə·ḥel·ḇê haš·šə·lā·mîm ū·ḇan·nə·sā·ḵîm lā·‘ō·lāh wat·tik·kō·wn ‘ă·ḇō·w·ḏaṯ bêṯ- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Furthermore the burnt offerings were abundant . . . along with the fat of the peace offerings and the drink offerings for the burnt offerings So the service of the house of the LORD was established
verses.literalPt: E houve também holocaustos em abundância, com a gordura das ofertas pacíficas, e com as ofertas de libação para os holocaustos. Assim se restabeleceu o ministério da casa do SENHOR.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׂמַ֤ח יְחִזְקִיָּ֙הוּ֙ וְכָל־ הָעָ֔ם עַ֛ל הַהֵכִ֥ין הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים לָעָ֑ם כִּ֥י בְּפִתְאֹ֖ם הָיָ֥ה הַדָּבָֽר׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yiś·maḥ yə·ḥiz·qî·yā·hū wə·ḵāl hā·‘ām ‘al ha·hê·ḵîn hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm lā·‘ām kî bə·p̄iṯ·’ōm hā·yāh had·dā·ḇār
verses.literal: Then Hezekiah and all the people rejoiced at what God had prepared for the people because everything had been accomplished so quickly
verses.literalPt: E Ezequias, e todo o povo se alegraram, por causa daquilo que Deus tinha preparado para o povo; porque apressuradamente se fez esta obra.
